Uttar pradesh vidhanasbha chunav 2027 ko lekar NDA ke bhitar sahyogi dalon ke bayanon se siyasi halchal tej ho gaee hai. Chirag Paswan ke 403 siton par chunav larne ke ailan ke bad ab Nitish Kumar ki parti JDU ne bhi yupi chunav ko lekar apna rukh saph kiya hai. kya BJP ke samne yupi men sahyogi dalon ki alag chunavi ranniti naee chunauti khari karegi? janie pura mamla.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
